name: PeelCornerCard
job: A card with a curling sticker corner that peels back to uncover a hidden offer, bonus or detail beneath
visitor_action: hover the corner or drag it to peel; tap peels fully on touch; Enter/Space toggles the peel, Escape flattens it
mobile: tap peels the corner in one animated motion
motion: corner curl follows pointer with real fold geometry, releases with spring ease; idle corner breathes (reduced-motion: corner pre-peeled showing message)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Full-bleed lemon vinyl sticker sheet that IS the component: two-tone printed sunburst, halftone screen, air-bubble pinpricks and blisters, gloss laminate, ink brand strip with tick rule; a huge ~50% corner peel whose clear adhesive back shows the mirrored sunburst; revealed ink field with rotating rays, rings, halftone and a notched coupon chip
notes: 2026-11-23: quality redo 2 (Sonnet 5.5, QA fail). Peel rebuilt as ~36% hero corner (true outline-clipped reflection, rounded flap, liner paper, layered canvas shadows, overhangs card when held); card fills with condensed-black headline fit to length, brand strip beside peel, ink well with staggered hidden offer. Not re-shot by builder (QA re-sweeps). Weakness: extreme worst-case footers can clip at 375; held peel covers most of the sticker by design. | 2026-11-23: composition round 2 - no stage: sticker fills the frame edge to edge (16:9 wide, 1:1, 4:5 by container width), peel ~50% idle with adhesive-back flap + mirrored print ghost, ink brand strip, composed ink reveal. Verified by hand in browser at 1280/375/worst (shot.sh not run). Weakness: body copy is line-clamped to 5 lines; held peel covers about half the sticker by design. 2026-11-24: de-skeuomorphic pass: removed air-bubble blisters, halftone dots, grain and adhesive haze; calmer single gloss; simpler wider sunburst; peel and fold kept.
